data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1225 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 186.2 million for the 2023 financial year, representing 15.15% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was calculated from the gross claims development table by comparing the current ultimate estimates to the previous year's diagonal estimates for underwriting years 2014 to 2021. The report's narrative on page 29, however, states a 'Favourable movement in technical provisions' of GBP 29.4 million for prior years' claims estimate, which appears to be a net figure and contradicts the gross strengthening. The report also generally mentions 'low attritional and catastrophe loss experience' and 'favourable loss experience' contributing to positive results, which seems to refer to the net position.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive result reflecting harder rating conditions, and low attritional and catastrophe loss experience.
The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 4% (2022: 7%) component of the 2023 loss ratio of 43% (2022: 47%).
